home.heroDescription: Three crafts under one roof, in the heart of Luxembourg's most enchanting quarter.
home.introText: La Grocerie du Gründ is a return to the essentials. A place where you rediscover the taste of good things: artisan sandwiches, a farm grocery and Luxembourg's first natural wine cellar. All in a spirit of local sourcing, short supply chains and community.
home.pillar1Desc: Our round, generous Mezzo sandwiches are filled with fresh seasonal products. Our house-made pastrami from nitrite-free Luxembourgish Angus beef is the star of the house.
home.pillar2Desc: A selection of local and organic products: artisan charcuterie, raw-milk cheeses, fresh bread, oils, condiments and more. From the producer to your table.
home.pillar3Desc: Over 200 natural, organic and biodynamic wine references, direct-imported from artisan winemakers across Europe. Tastings every Thursday.
home.aboutText: The name La Grocerie comes from old French for grocery shop, reflecting a clear desire to get back to the basics of what neighbourhood grocery shops used to be. We opened in 2023, but 1923 suited us better — so we stamped that date on the storefront.
home.eventsDesc: Every Thursday, the cellar comes alive with friendly tastings. We also offer a catering service for your private events.

mezzocuore.heroDesc: Mezzo sandwiches on house-made pizza dough bread, round and generous, filled with fresh seasonal products.

mezzocuore.mezzoDesc: Our round pizza dough sandwiches, generously filled. Meat, fish or vegetarian — something for everyone.
mezzocuore.pucciaDesc: Traditional sandwiches from Puglia, filled with artisan Italian products.
mezzocuore.soupDesc: Fresh and seasonal, served with artisan bread.
mezzocuore.coffeeDesc: Espresso, cappuccino and artisan drinks to complement your meal.
mezzocuore.note: Limited daily menu, always fresh. All products selected for quality and provenance.

epicerie.heroDesc: A selection of local and organic products, from the producer to your table. Short supply chains, artisan quality.
epicerie.charcuterieDesc: Smoked ham, saucisson, coppa and rillettes from local producers.

epicerie.condimentsDesc: Olive oils, vinegars, mustards and jams from producers.

about.conceptP1: The name La Grocerie comes from old French for grocery shop, reflecting a clear desire to get back to the basics of what neighbourhood grocery shops used to be. We opened in 2023, but 1923 suited us better — so we stamped that date on the storefront.
about.conceptP2: Under one roof, you'll find an artisan sandwich shop, a farm grocery and Luxembourg's first natural wine cellar. Every product is selected for quality and provenance, every supplier is a local partner.
about.conceptP3: Once inside, a large mural reflects the founding principles of the project: local, short supply chains, community. All furniture has been upcycled to reduce our ecological footprint.
about.philoP1: We champion quality food that is accessible and rooted in the terroir. Our producers are our neighbours — from Luxembourgish farms to artisan winemakers across Europe.
about.philoP2: La Cave de la Grocerie was born from the collaboration between Eric Vantieghem, importer of clean wines since 2007, and Servan Bernard, founder of the wine bar Vins Fins and La Grocerie. Together, they offer a wide selection of natural wines through direct import.
about.philoP3: Every Thursday, the cellar becomes a place for sharing through friendly tastings. The rules are rewritten — the bling is set aside in favour of what truly matters: enjoyment, discovery and human connection.
about.valuesLocalDesc: We favour local and organic products, from the producer to your plate.
about.valuesCommunityDesc: More than a shop — a gathering place for food and wine lovers.
about.valuesShortChainDesc: Direct import, no middlemen. From the farm and vineyard to your table.
about.ctaDesc: Push the door of La Grocerie du Gründ. Sandwiches, fine grocery or a good glass of natural wine await you.

events.tastingDesc: Every Thursday evening, the cellar comes alive. Come discover exceptional natural wines in a friendly, relaxed atmosphere. No pretension, just pleasure and discovery.
events.tastingNote: Free entry. Follow us on Instagram for the programme.
events.cateringDesc: For your private or professional events, we offer a bespoke catering service: charcuterie and cheese boards, artisan sandwiches, natural wine selection.
events.cateringNote: Contact us via DM on Instagram or by email to discuss your project.
events.privateDesc: La Grocerie is a perfect setting for intimate private events. A few tables, a unique atmosphere, exceptional products.
events.ctaDesc: Contact us to discuss your project. Tastings, catering, private events — we adapt to your needs.

contact.gettingHereText: Street parking on Rue Münster. Nearest car park: Parking du Grund (5 min walk). The free Grund elevator connects from the Plateau du Saint-Esprit.
contact.dmDesc: For event bookings, catering or any questions, reach out via DM on Instagram or by email.
